comment: Automatic service restart for MON-PRX Windows servers. Signed with the update manifest. auto_all: off = only the host's recover list; report = also list the stopped Automatic services in would_start without starting them; on = start them. exclude: services that stop by design (name or display name, * allowed). hosts.<Zabbix host name>.recover: extra services to keep running (any start type except Disabled); hosts.<name>.exclude: services never started on that host.
